title: Data & Analytics Graduate Programme
description:
About Us

We are a business and technology consultancy , recruiting the brightest talent to become the innovators of tomorrow. We have centres across Europe, North America and Asia-Pacific, and a global workforce of over 3,500 employees.

Isabel - Data Analyst

FDM has shown exponential growth throughout the years, firmly establishing itself as an award-winning employer and is listed on the FTSE4Good Index.

About The Role

Join our Data & Analytics Team and become a data pro in one of the most influential careers in the tech industry.

The era of big data is here, with emerging technologies like artificial intelligence and machine learning having so much influence on business decision-making. Whether it’s navigating the intricacies of data extraction with structured query language (SQL) or designing websites and dashboards, you will gain expertise across a range of technical areas.

Our industry-certified training will have you mastering business intelligence practices, like diverse data modelling and warehousing, turning large unstructured data sets into valuable business insights.

Explore diverse and exciting roles on client assignments. Master the skills and tools to forecast, analyse and harness data and learn the fundamentals of business intelligence, data engineering and machine learning.

You’ll be joining FDM as an Associate Consultant within our Data and Analytics Practice, where you will be delivering large-scale projects for our clients across a wide range of sectors and specialist areas. You could be taking on the role of BI Developer, Robotic Process Automation (RPA) Consultant, Data Engineer, Data Scientist or Machine Learning Engineer, with access to continuous upskilling and career development opportunities.

Progression at FDM will see you climb the ranks to Consultant, Senior Consultant and Principal Consultant level, as you develop your skillset and deliver expert consultative work to our clients.

About You

Where ambition meets opportunity

At FDM, we find driven people from diverse backgrounds. Dedicated to your continuous growth, we offer a non-linear career journey with our Skills Lab helping guide you to the future you want.

Your skillsets will grow. Clients will value your increased expertise. And your career will thrive exponentially .

Minimum requirements:

Degree level qualification (2:2 or higher)

Excellent communication skills and proven ability to work in a team

Demonstrable interest and desire to work in technology

Commitment to at least two years of employment with FDM

The right to work in the UK

Flexibility to take on client assignments across the South of England

Why join us?

Career coaching and access to upskilling throughout your entire FDM career

Initial upskilling pre-assignment that has been accredited by TechSkills

Assignments with global companies and opportunities to work abroad

Opportunity to obtain certifications from Microsoft, Salesforce, Cisco and more

We've signed the Gradcracker feedback pledge.

(This means that we will supply feedback if requested after an interview.)
